source_review.notes: Checked ACM publication and DOI metadata for Wagner-Fischer, Hirschberg, Myers bit-vector, and Navarro; Elsevier metadata for Ukkonen; and Springer/Algorithmica metadata for Myers's O(ND) paper. Algorithm-family claims preserve their distinct edit-cost, threshold, word, and output models.

evidence: Checked prefix, DP-cell, indicator, edit-graph, threshold, infinity, script, and complexity notation; checked display recurrence syntax and balanced GitHub math delimiters.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The unit-cost Levenshtein model is separated from insertion/deletion shortest-edit scripts and Damerau-style transpositions.

evidence: Recomputed kitten/sitting, sunday/saturday, cat/cut, ab/ba, book/back rows, length lower bounds, weighted asymmetry, and the 100001-squared table capacity example.
Exhaustively checked 16,129 binary-string pairs through length 6 and 96,774 threshold results against the full DP, including symmetry and length/maximum bounds.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Every bounded result equaled the exact distance when within threshold and returned no exact value otherwise.

evidence: Re-derived the recurrence by classifying the final operation and as shortest paths in an acyclic edit graph.
Re-derived unit-cost lower and upper bounds, metric properties, rolling-row dependencies, band safety, and script replay conditions.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Weighted and normalized variants are not assigned unit-cost metric guarantees.

evidence: Checked empty sequences, one-sided empty input, equal inputs, unequal lengths, all mismatch, repeated symbols, transposition, thresholds zero and around the answer, and multiple optimal scripts.
Checked Unicode representation changes, zero/asymmetric weights, infinity overflow, matrix-allocation overflow, quadratic denial of service, cancellation, sensitive logging, and output growth.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Threshold failure, resource failure, invalid input, and unavailable execution use distinct result meanings.

evidence: Checked exact prefix-state meaning, acyclic predecessor reduction, boundary costs, rolling-row ownership, infinity outside the band, and script replay/cost equality.
Exhaustive testing checked full versus banded agreement for thresholds 0 through 5 over every finite pair in the selected domain.
invariant_checking.notes: Two-row distance and traceback evidence are kept separate.

evidence: Reviewed both lower-bound and construction directions of the optimal-prefix induction.
Reviewed nonnegativity, identity, symmetry, and triangle inequality only for the symmetric unit-cost model.
Reviewed band safety from coordinate-difference changes on insertion/deletion edges.
proof_review.notes: The $O(mk)$ band claim includes the immediate length-difference rejection and at most 2k+1 live cells per row.

evidence: Audited theorem, lemma, proof, exact, approximate, optimal, metric, weighted, normalized, linear-space, quadratic, threshold, expected, and word-parallel language.
Separated mathematical exactness, finite execution, domain usefulness, benchmark evidence, and human diff quality.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Approximate matching is correctly distinguished from approximate numerical answers.

evidence: The CPython 3.14.4 snippet exited zero with exact full and bounded-distance output on macOS 13.7.8 x86_64.
Independent exhaustive checks covered 16,129 pairs and 96,774 threshold decisions.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Execution establishes behavior only for the recorded runtime and finite test domain; no throughput claim is inferred.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed sequence representation, operation models, optimal-prefix recurrence, edit graph, bounds, rolling storage, traceback, banding, weighted costs, neighboring algorithm families, tie-breaking, service contracts, and evidence boundaries. Scope leaves alignment scoring and affine gaps to ALGE-058.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed Unicode/token policy, operation-version compatibility, rolling-row overwrite hazards, band sentinels, cost overflow, allocation arithmetic, dispatch fallbacks, script replay, deterministic ties, tagged outcomes, quotas, cancellation, sensitive data, and workload-stratified benchmarking.

pedagogical_review.notes: The Level-II chapter derives exact DP and banding from first principles, distinguishes adjacent models and evidence types, includes ten distinct recurrence, boundary, representation, threshold, weighted, capacity, and script examples, and ends with five progressive exercises and complete answers.

limitations: Internal source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical review only; no external academic, linguistic, biomedical, fairness, privacy, performance, security, or operational review is claimed. Results remain conditional on the declared sequence units, equality, edit operations, costs, threshold, algorithm, script, and resource assumptions.
